method: Manually inspected exact Census USPS/GEOID/NAME to exact CMS state/county labels. No national suffix stripping, fuzzy match or ZIP inference. A named-city request requires separately cited city-to-county confirmation.

place_to_county_evidence.observation: The city's official page locates the City of Naples in Collier County.
place_to_county_evidence.limitation: This county query does not establish a person's residence from a postal city or ZIP.

scope.all_counties_rule: Include exact-state All Counties rows only when category and plan type are PDP. This release has 476 such rows, all PDP. Preserve All Counties as source scope; do not rewrite it to a county offering.
scope.purpose: Read-only source experiment. Not a launch approval, eligibility assessment, personalized ranking, quote or enrollment list.
